name: 3-Ingredient Taquero-Style Guacamole

ingredients.name: ripe Hass avocado, halved, pitted, and flesh scooped
cilantro leaves, tender stems washed and dried
serrano chile, seeded if desired to reduce spiciness
kosher salt, plus more to taste

instructions.primary_message: In a blender, blend avocado, cilantro, serrano, water, and 1 teaspoon salt until completely smooth. Season to taste with additional salt as needed. Serve.

description: This taquero-style guacamole is pourable, creamy, and spicy with a fresh kick of cilantro. It’s closer to an avocado sauce than to a classic chunky guac. Spoon it over tacos, quesadillas, burritos, nachos, and more.
notes:
Notes: A seeded jalapeño can be substituted for the serrano chile for an even less spicy option.

Make-ahead and storage: The guacamole sauce is best eaten the same day it's made. It should be refrigerated in an air-tight container when not in use (a squeeze bottle works great). Second-day leftovers still taste good, and light oxidation on top disappears with stirring. After that, the loss of flavor and color become increasingly noticeable.
author: Rose Egelhoff
Paco Gaztelum
